name: Science fiction in four parts
hint: The new thing, its consequences, the crisis and the new world: one idea followed to its end.

parts.title: The new thing
chapters: A world in motion
The main character in the middle of a concrete task in an unfamiliar everyday life. The details hint at the world without explaining it.
The novum
The new thing appears, or its first unexpected effect, and the reader understands that something has changed.
The personal stake
The new thing touches the main character directly, and we see what they stand to lose.
The way in
They make the decision that ties them to the question, and there is no way back.

parts.title: The consequences
chapters: The rules
They learn how the new thing works through trial and error, not through a lecture.
Ripples
Consequences at the second and third remove: who wins, who loses and what breaks.
Wonder
A scene of scale and wonder, where the reader sees what the new thing makes possible.
The midpoint
A reveal about what the new thing really is, or really costs, turns the whole question around.

parts.title: The crisis
chapters: The system strikes back
Those in power, institutions or the technology itself respond, and the stakes grow.
The logical consequence
The rules are followed to their uncomfortable conclusion: the worst that can happen, by the world's own logic.
The lowest point
They lose what they were holding on to, and the old solution no longer works.
The answer in the rules
They find the solution in something the reader already understands about the new thing. No new inventions.

parts.title: The new world
chapters: The decision
The main character acts and pays for it. A human choice decides, not just the technology.
Afterwards
The world and the person after the change. Answer the book's what if, or leave a question the reader carries with them.
